notes.title: Baten Kaitos Ⅰ & Ⅱ HD Remaster is available now on Steam
notes.content:
[h3][b]The BATEN KAITOS™ series[/b] features the Magnus Battle System, a unique card-based mechanic where cards are dealt from the deck to determine attack power based on the attributes and combination of cards available. In these real-time battles, players must make quick decision-making to claim victory. In this series, players assume the role of the Guardian Spirit, guiding the protagonist and their companions through distinctive adventures in each game. 
[/h3]
[h3]Watch the launch trailer for BATEN KAITOS I & II HD REMASTER on PC via Steam® at the following link:[/h3]
[previewyoutube=90cMDHbjlzk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]A new illustration commemorating the Steam® release, drawn by the Baten Kaitos series’ character designer, Nakaba Higurashi, has also been unveiled today.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45064632/ce815ad866f083a1dfa3c766f7f1baa8bf2b687e.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]The BATEN KAITOS™ [/b]series features the Magnus Battle System, a unique card-based mechanic where cards are dealt from the deck to determine attack power based on the attributes and combination of cards available. 

[b]BATEN KAITOS: ETERNAL WINGS AND THE LOST OCEAN[/b] tells the story of Kalas who, while seeking revenge for the death of his brother and grandfather, meets Xelha as they both embark on a journey to defeat the Alfard Empire. 

[b]BATEN KAITOS ORIGINS[/b] takes place 20 years before the events of the first game. The story involves Sagi, a “spiriter” that has a connection with Guardian Spirits who is part of the Dark Service, an elite unit of the Alfard Empire.

[b]BATEN KAITOS I & II HD REMASTER[/b] enhances the gameplay of the original titles through several new features and settings to support game progression. 
[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2146170/

notes.title: Bandai Namco just surprise-dropped 2 classic Baten Kaitos RPGs on Steam
notes.content: Eleven whole months ago, a South African ratings board indicated that the Baten Kaitos 1 & 2 HD Remaster collection existed for PC, despite 2023's Bandai Namco only announcing it for the Nintendo Switch. That's a long time for a PC release to be MIA with no other sign it exists, but all of a sudden, whammo, here we are—Baten Kaitos 1 & 2 are out on Steam right now, after being released on the Nintendo Switch last September... Read more.
